title: SCKit abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions
content: Beginning November 11, 2026, threat actors gained unauthorized access to cloud-hosted ConnectWise ScreenConnect instances belonging to managed service providers. The attackers abuse ScreenConnect, a legitimate remote-support application, to install unauthorized remote-access clients and deploy SCKit, a malicious worm, on customer-managed endpoints. title: WardenStealer Malware: Turning AI Access into an Underground Commodity
content: WardenStealer is a Rust-based Windows infostealer first observed in November 2026 that specializes in stealing credentials, authentication tokens, cookies, API keys, and local AI application files targeting platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor. title: The Retadup USB worm is back to spread CoffeeLoader
content: In August 2026, a new CoffeeLoader malware variant was identified, utilizing an NSIS-based installer that drops a patched 7z.dll file containing malicious shellcode.
